h1: Custom 28 oz Barware for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Browse custom 28 oz barware at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for branded glassware and drinkware. Order bulk today!
introHtml: Custom 28 oz barware offers a substantial serving size ideal for beer mugs, pint glasses, or stemware that makes an impression at events, bars, and corporate gifts. The 28 oz capacity stands out from standard 16 oz options, giving recipients a generous pour that keeps your logo visible longer. Whether you are outfitting a company taproom or sourcing promotional drinkware for a trade show, these oversized pieces pair well with ceramic or glass construction and can be decorated with screen printing, etching, or full-wrap designs for maximum brand impact.
heroAltText: Custom 28 oz barware featuring a branded pint glass with screen-printed logo, perfect for promotional drinkware.
